title: Admin shell
summary: The frame of an admin screen: the alert bar over everything, the admin menu's column, the page head and the content; the document scrolls, the bar, the menu and on a phone a slim top line stay; the skip link first, the menu's room held before it draws, list or reading width.

template.description: Template variant name for SfBaseElement external templates.

root-class.description: Classes added to the root element the component draws.

root-style.description: Inline style declarations set on the root element the component draws, custom properties included.

width.description: The content's width (C329): list -- the whole work area; read -- the reading width (--sf-container-1--size-max, 960) at the start, for forms and text.

menu-reserve.description: The room held for the menu before it has drawn, so the work area does not move when it comes (AM-18): rail -- the rail (56); rail-column -- the rail and the section column (56 + 256), the rail alone when the menu says expected-columns 1 (the page's row has no open root) or the person hid the column (the menu's own preference); none -- nothing. The server knows whether the page's section has a column.

product.description: The product's name in the phone top line («Larena Panel»).

skip-label.description: The skip link's text; empty is «Перейти к содержимому» in the page's language.

menu-open.description: Whether the phone menu is open (C322): the menu takes the work area's place below 44rem. Written by the menu button, Escape, a page chosen in the menu, or the page; on a wide screen it changes nothing.

top-end.description: The phone top line's end: the activity indicator and the bell (C342).

openMenu.summary: Opens the phone menu (menu-open); focus goes to the menu's first control. Refused no-menu when the shell holds no menu.

closeMenu.summary: Closes the phone menu; focus goes back to the menu button.

focusContent.summary: Moves the focus to the work area (the main landmark) and scrolls it to the top: the skip link does it, and a product after it changed the page without a reload.

sf-admin-shell-menu-open.summary: The phone menu opened: by its button or by the action open-menu.

sf-admin-shell-menu-close.summary: The phone menu closed: its button, Escape, a page chosen in the menu (sf-admin-menu-navigate), the window grown past the phone width, the work area focused, or the action close-menu.

forbidden_client_responsibilities: drawing the page head or the menu

accessibility.focus: The skip link first; it focuses the work area (main, tabindex -1, named by the h1). The phone menu button holds aria-expanded and aria-controls; opening moves the focus into the menu, closing back to the button.

changes: On a phone with the menu open, Escape goes first to a layer opened over it (the bell's panel, a menu, a window) and closes the menu only when no such layer is open. Nothing to change for a host.

ai_guidance.use_when: Use sf-admin-shell once per admin screen around sf-alert-bar (slot bar), sf-admin-menu (slot menu), sf-header-page (slot head) and the content.
do_not: Do not give the work area its own scroll box: the document scrolls
Do not draw a second skip link or a second main landmark
Do not put the bell or the activity indicator in the content: on a phone they go to slot top-end
